cli_capabilities._comment: What each CLI offers, as verified offline on the date below. The Conftest policy (policy/model_policy.rego) and the drift checker (scripts/check-model-policy.mjs, npm run ai:models) both read this file, so it is JSON. Update it only after re-verifying; sources are in the 'source' fields.

claude.source: Claude Code 2.1.303: claude --help lists fable, opus and sonnet aliases and low, medium, high, xhigh, max effort; haiku is documented at https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config. alias_resolution_2_1_303 is the installed CLI bundle's default family map for the Anthropic API; provider and account settings can override alias resolution. The drift checker does not start an agent.

codex.source: codex debug models --bundled (the catalog shipped inside the binary; models with visibility "list", effort levels from supported_reasoning_levels). The non-bundled `codex debug models` can refresh from the network and differs by account, so it is not used. Selection: codex exec -m <model> -c model_reasoning_effort="<level>" (codex exec --help for -m and -p; model_reasoning_effort is a config and profile key per the openai/codex docs via Context7).
